'''Executor''' was a title bestowed upon the non&ndash;[[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith Pureblood]] [[Krannus]] by the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] for his fanatical loyalty and the speed with which he rose through the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]].<ref name="Anarchy" />
